title: Context Menu
description: The right-click menu, written as a component instead of an accident of the browser.
usage: For dense surfaces — file rows, canvas items, table cells — where actions belong to the thing under the cursor. Always mirror the same actions somewhere visible; a context menu is a shortcut, never the only door.
a11y: Opens on the contextmenu event and on Shift+F10 / the Menu key for keyboard users, takes focus, and returns it on Esc. Items are real buttons.
